name: defense
description: Working to preserve the state of things relating to yourself or important social contact.

variations.name: defending territory and assets
variations.description: To have enough resources to safely survive, many animals mark their terrory and are willing to fight to defend it. In modern times, social assets like money and job responsibilities may prompt protection.

variations.name: defending life and health
variations.description: Taking steps to protect yourself or someone else from perceived threats ranging from minor illness to mortal danger.

variations.name: defending reputation
variations.description: There are reactive and proactive ways to protect social status from perceived threats. These actions may protect yourself or an important other.

conditions: Self is acting on a goal to protect something of value, whether for the self or for another agent.
